finding.title: The use of `srand(static_cast<unsigned int>(time(nullptr)));` is not secure for cryptographic purposes.
The `health` variable in the `TargetDummy` class is an `int`. If the damage taken exceeds the maximum value of an `int`, it could lead to integer overflow.
There is no input validation for the initial health value or the damage values.
The loop condition `while (dummy.isAlive() && elapsedTimeSeconds <= ability1.durationSeconds)` could potentially lead to an infinite loop.

There is no input validation for the initial health value or the damage values.
